title: Ashbury Rewards Rate Card: Daily Dining Amount per Person (Guest Folios)
content:
The daily dining amount per person used for an Ashbury Rewards member's dining allowance on Guest Folios is set by tier.

**Rate.** Daily dining amount per person: the Ambassador daily dining amount of $95.00 for an Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite member, the Titanium daily dining amount of $80.00 for an Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite member, and the brand's elite breakfast credit per person for every other member.

The tier is the tier shown on the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay.

| Ashbury Rewards tier | Daily dining amount per person |
|---|---|
| Ambassador Elite | $95.00 |
| Titanium Elite | $80.00 |
| Any other tier | The brand's elite breakfast credit per person |

## Reading the rate card

- The figure is per person and per business date.
- The Ambassador and Titanium amounts are fixed figures and do not vary by brand; the figure for every other member is the brand's own elite breakfast credit per person, and so varies by brand.

Hypothetical illustration: for an Ambassador Elite member the daily dining amount per person is $95.00 at every brand; for a Gold Elite member staying at a brand whose elite breakfast credit per person is $18.00 it is $18.00.
